builds.name: Reference: AP dive
builds.goal: Reference for Kennen: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged skirmisher who accumulates storm marks, then uses speed to deliver an area stun ultimate. Compare mark-based stun and R contact with a real W/passive attack experiment. Energy, mark cooldowns and getting into ult range prevent unlimited spell/attack procs. AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window.
builds.summary: AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window.
testPlan: Kit question for Kennen: Compare mark-based stun and R contact with a real W/passive attack experiment. Energy, mark cooldowns and getting into ult range prevent unlimited spell/attack procs.

Start with the early core (Rocketbelt, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Energy. Do not treat mana regeneration as Energy recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: The active cannot replace every mobility tool; minimal sustained durability.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: The active cannot replace every mobility tool; minimal sustained durability.
Full cost 16,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Rocketbelt, then Shadowflame. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Energy. Do not treat mana regeneration as Energy recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

builds.name: Lightning Rush crit extension
builds.summary: Keep the post-Rush attack-speed window alive through real crits.
builds.goal: Keep the post-Rush attack-speed window alive through real crits.
builds.hypothesis: Lightning Rush grants 50-90% attack speed for four seconds after ending, and current primary text says critical strikes extend it one second. Yun Tal builds crit through attacks, Infinity Edge supports actual crit damage, and Stormrazor helps kite while W's every-fifth attack adds magic damage with AP/AD terms. Terminus addresses the mixed ordinary attack and W output.
testPlan: Required state: Need E ended, actual crit attacks landing and W counter tracked.
Measure extension duration, crit count and fifth-W damage versus an enemy that disengages.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: No attack access means the window expires; AD investment weakens Q/R burst and mobility consumes energy.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Extension is conditional on crit events; E itself does not crit or grant permanent attack speed.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Yun Tal Wildarrows, Infinity Edge, Stormrazor, Terminus, Bloodthirster, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Storm resistance shred dive
builds.summary: Use repeated storm hits to develop shred while surviving the stun cycle.
builds.goal: Use repeated storm hits to develop shred while surviving the stun cycle.
builds.hypothesis: Slicing Maelstrom hits every 0.5 seconds for three seconds, gains damage on successive hits and grants armor/MR. Bloodletter can shred MR through qualifying ability hits; Riftmaker needs sustained combat and Rocketbelt helps maintain storm contact. Zhonya's is a survival tool after committing, while passive marks require three stacks for a stun and energy return.
testPlan: Required state: Need an entry angle, enemy escape constrained and passive marks developing on priority targets.
Track storm hit count, shred stacks and stun timing against two separated moving targets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Blink escapes or early interruption limits storm hits; holding Zhonya too long risks dying first.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Six ticks are not guaranteed on every target and repeated marks have their own stun behavior.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Rocketbelt, Bloodletter's Curse, Riftmaker, Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
